aiGuidance.extraction: Title: the field `title` is this type's label in lists and outlines (the type's identity). Set it on every option: a short human-readable noun phrase naming the record, distinct from siblings. The code or key field stays as the stable id and is not the label.
aiGuidance.negativeGuidance: The title must not be the code or key, or strengthen or soften what the record says. Never overwrite a title a person has set.

description: A reusable possible path, independent of any one argument.
name: option
